name: GTs On The Bay
description: GTs On The Bay sits overlooking Wolf Bay on Canal Road in the heart of Orange Beach. With stunning views and bay front dining, GTs features a diverse and one-of-a-kind menu. Guests can savor unique culinary choices and a blend of local favorites, in addition to special creations with a family friendly atmosphere. Enjoy a stone hearth pizza oven and fresh made salad bar as well as craft beers and daily happy hour.
address_line_1: 26189 Canal Rd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA
